crew.overview: When a madman dubbed 'Scorpio' terrorizes San Francisco, hard-nosed cop, Harry Callahan – famous for his take-no-prisoners approach to law enforcement – is tasked with hunting down the psychopath.
crew.title: Dirty Harry

details.biography: Fred Stromsoe was born on June 15, 1930 in Denver, Colorado, USA. He was an actor and assistant director, known for "Adam-12 (1968)", "The Wild Wild West (1965)" and "What's Up, Doc? (1972)". He was married to Nancy Berry. He died on September 30, 1994 in Los Angeles, California, USA.
details.name: Fred Stromsoe
